items.h: Drusen-driven disease progressed to advanced AMD substantially more often than pachychoroid-driven disease over 5 years in a Korean prospective cohort (Ophthalmology Science)
items.ctx: In the multicenter Korean Age-Related Maculopathy Study of 868 participants (335 completed 5-year follow-up), the complete-case 5-year incidence was 20.4% for exudative AMD and 12.2% for geographic atrophy in drusen-driven disease vs 5.0% and 2.2% in pachychoroid-driven disease. Within drusen-driven disease, reticular pseudodrusen were associated with geographic atrophy (OR, 10.21; 95% CI, 3.02-34.49), while in pachychoroid-driven disease pachydrusen were not associated with progression and exudative conversion was confined to eyes with both pigmentary abnormality and the double-layer sign.

items.h: Disease severity varied substantially among patients sharing identical primary EYS or USH2A genotypes in autosomal-recessive retinitis pigmentosa (TVST)
items.ctx: In 90 patients (41 EYS, 49 USH2A), several genotype-matched comparisons showed younger individuals with substantially smaller ellipsoid zone widths than older counterparts, and the authors say this variability has implications for prognosis, trial stratification, and interpretation of treatment response.

items.h: The RHO p.(Met216Lys) variant is associated with a slowly progressive chorioretinal dystrophy that can closely mimic choroideremia (IOVS)
items.ctx: In 17 patients from eight families at four centers (follow-up available for 13, median 159 months), findings included enlarging pericentral scotomas, coalescing patches of autofluorescence loss, outer retinal tubulations, a thinned choroid, and a median ellipsoid zone width loss of 176 µm per year.

items.h: FDA is requiring safety labeling changes for all GLP-1 receptor agonists to add a potential increased risk of nonarteritic anterior ischemic optic neuropathy (NAION)
items.ctx: In an FDA meta-analysis of 126 randomized trials with 134,253 patients, NAION incidence was 6.4 events per 100,000 person-years with GLP-1 RAs vs 3.8 with comparators (placebo or non-GLP-1 RA glucose-lowering drugs); FDA identified 15 probable NAION events. In Sentinel data on adults with type 2 diabetes, the hazard ratio was 1.43 (95% CI, 1.02-2.01) vs DPP-4 inhibitors and 1.19 (95% CI, 0.91-1.54; not statistically significant) vs SGLT-2 inhibitors.

items.h: Fenofibrate added to a statin was associated with a lower hazard of a DME-related composite after cataract surgery in type 2 diabetes (Retina)
items.ctx: In a TriNetX cohort of 2,521 matched pairs, the hazard ratio was 0.486 (95% CI, 0.324-0.728) at 1 year and 0.678 (95% CI, 0.515-0.892) at 5 years; findings for the PDR-related composite were inconclusive, and the authors state that prospective validation is needed.

items.h: An open-source multimodal imaging data set of 645 eyes with uveal melanoma, choroidal nevi, or congenital hypertrophy of the retinal pigment epithelium has been released (Ophthalmology Science)
items.ctx: The single-center collection pairs ultra-widefield fundus photographs with standardized B-scan ultrasonography and structured annotations, and prior AI models built on it reached an AUC of up to 0.98 for distinguishing uveal melanoma from choroidal nevus.

lead.h: FDA is requiring safety labeling changes for all GLP-1 receptor agonists to add a potential increased risk of nonarteritic anterior ischemic optic neuropathy (NAION)
lead.ctx: In an FDA meta-analysis of 126 randomized trials with 134,253 patients, NAION incidence was 6.4 events per 100,000 person-years with GLP-1 RAs vs 3.8 with comparators (placebo or non-GLP-1 RA glucose-lowering drugs); FDA identified 15 probable NAION events. In Sentinel data on adults with type 2 diabetes, the hazard ratio was 1.43 (95% CI, 1.02-2.01) vs DPP-4 inhibitors and 1.19 (95% CI, 0.91-1.54; not statistically significant) vs SGLT-2 inhibitors.
lead.why: FDA advises clinicians to tell patients on GLP-1 RAs to report sudden, painless vision loss or other visual disturbances in one eye immediately, to promptly refer patients with suspected NAION to an ophthalmologist, and to consider discontinuing the drug in patients who develop NAION unless the benefits clearly outweigh the risk.

items.h: Thicker choroid and shorter axial length were independently associated with early AMD in a Korean national survey (AJO)
items.ctx: In the Korea National Health and Nutrition Examination Survey 2017-2020 (15,388 adults aged 40 years or older; 13,807 in ocular analyses), greater subfoveal choroidal thickness (OR per 10 µm, 1.03; 95% CI, 1.02-1.03) and shorter axial length (OR per 1 mm, 0.76; 95% CI, 0.71-0.82) were associated with early AMD.

items.h: New Swiss startup VisioSurgical Solutions begins developing a compact retinal surgery robot
items.ctx: The robotic head is designed to work with existing microscopes and intraoperative imaging, with gene and cell therapy delivery among first applications; the system is in development and not available for sale.

lead.h: Retinal imaging was rare in the year after tamoxifen initiation in a US cohort (JAMA Ophthalmology)
lead.ctx: Among 2327 individuals starting tamoxifen in the All of Us program, 162 (7.0%) had an ophthalmic encounter within 12 months and 39 (1.7%) underwent retinal OCT or fundus photography. Among participants with breast cancer, tamoxifen use was not associated with greater adjusted 12-month ophthalmic use than aromatase inhibitor use (aOR, 1.10; 95% CI, 0.85-1.42)
lead.why: With no formal US tamoxifen retinal screening guideline, the authors say additional evidence on retinopathy incidence, natural history, screening strategies, and clinical benefit is needed to inform guidance.

numbers.label: Share of 2327 individuals starting tamoxifen who underwent retinal OCT or fundus photography within 12 months.
Affected individuals from 10 unrelated families carrying bi-allelic PRKCZ variants.

items.h: TWO-ROP’s single 36-week exam would have potentially missed 20 treatment-requiring ROP cases under US screening criteria in a 14,198-infant Chinese cohort (Ophthalmology Retina)
items.ctx: Under US criteria, the 36-week rule identified 275 of 295 TR-ROP cases (sensitivity, 93.2%; 95% CI, 89.7%-95.8%), 14 of the 20 potentially missed cases had aggressive ROP, and moving the exam to 35 weeks raised sensitivity to 98.6%. Under Chinese criteria, the 36-week rule identified all 89 TR-ROP cases.

items.h: Nacuity doses first patient in phase 3 SLO-RP Preserve trial of oral NPI-001 for Usher syndrome–associated RP
items.ctx: The randomized, double-masked, 24-month trial (NCT07710196) will enroll up to 80 adults in the US and Australia, who will take NPI-001 (N-acetylcysteine amide) or placebo tablets twice daily to test whether it slows disease progression by reducing photoreceptor loss.

items.h: Small pupils were associated with Plus disease grading in ROP telemedicine imaging (Ophthalmology Retina)
items.ctx: Across 10,503 eye-sessions from 1,131 infants in the SUNDROP program, small (≤5 mm) vs large pupils had an adjusted OR of 2.41 (95% CI, 1.36-4.29) for Plus disease, and among small pupils additional images did not improve detection of any ICROP3 parameter.

lead.why: In this retrospective multicenter cohort, the algorithm’s performance varied by which screening criteria defined the eligible population, and the authors say screening strategies should be adapted to local criteria, with screening timing individualized to clinical setting and level of care.

items.h: Most DME eyes treated with the Port Delivery Platform reached normal retinal thickness, but fluid resolution was slow in some (AJO, Pagoda post hoc analysis)
items.ctx: In the Pagoda trial's adjusted intent-to-treat population, 87.9% of eyes in the PDS arm (n=272) reached a central subfield thickness of 325 µm or less by the last visit, at a mean of 21.3 weeks; in a detailed OCT analysis of 56 PDS eyes from 8 sites, intraretinal fluid in the central 1 mm cleared in 84% at a median of 68 weeks. The retrospective analysis includes Genentech-employed coauthors.

items.h: FDA grants orphan drug designation to Octant's oral OCT-980 for retinitis pigmentosa
items.ctx: The investigational small molecule is designed to correct rhodopsin protein misfolding in RHO-associated autosomal dominant retinitis pigmentosa and is being evaluated in a phase 1/2 study (NCT07408232)

items.h: Private insurers reimbursed less than public insurers for pediatric vitreoretinal procedures in a Texas billing review (Retina)
items.ctx: Across 394 visits from 282 patients, the median reimbursement percentage was 34.0% (equivalent to 85% of the Medicare rate), with 35.1% for public vs 26.5% for private insurers, and 24.1% of visits received zero payment.

lead.h: Most DME eyes treated with the Port Delivery Platform reached normal retinal thickness, but fluid resolution was slow in some (AJO, Pagoda post hoc analysis)
lead.ctx: In the Pagoda trial's adjusted intent-to-treat population, 87.9% of eyes in the PDS arm (n=272) reached a central subfield thickness of 325 µm or less by the last visit, at a mean of 21.3 weeks; in a detailed OCT analysis of 56 PDS eyes from 8 sites, intraretinal fluid in the central 1 mm cleared in 84% at a median of 68 weeks. The retrospective analysis includes Genentech-employed coauthors.
lead.why: The authors argue that, under sustained VEGF-A suppression, apparent nonresponse in DME may often be slow response and propose the term "slowly responsive" instead of "unresponsive", a conclusion drawn from a post hoc analysis of a single trial.

numbers.label: Of 56 PDS-treated DME eyes with detailed OCT analysis, the share in which central intraretinal fluid cleared (median, 68 weeks).

items.h: Oral belzutifan is associated with regression of retinal capillary hemangioblastomas in von Hippel-Lindau disease
items.ctx: In a retrospective National Eye Institute case series of 33 patients (42 eyes, 85 active lesions), mean total active lesion area per eye fell from 5.8 to 1.2 mm² at 1 year and to 0.5 mm² at 2 years, with no new lesions during treatment. Among patients who discontinued therapy, over 70% of eyes showed signs of relapse.

items.h: Subthreshold micropulse laser plus anti-VEGF for DME is associated with fewer injections than anti-VEGF alone in a meta-analysis
items.ctx: Across 9 studies (535 eyes), combination therapy required 2.1 fewer anti-VEGF injections over 12 months (MD, −2.1; 95% CI, −3.0 to −1.1), while the 12-month BCVA change marginally favored combination therapy (P = .0497) but was not significant when limited to RCTs, and certainty of evidence for the primary outcome was graded low.

items.h: AAO technology assessment links OCT pRNFL and GC-IPL metrics to multiple sclerosis progression
items.ctx: Across 21 studies (2 level I, 8 level II, 11 level III), lower baseline thickness, faster thinning and larger interocular differences in pRNFL and macular GC-IPL were associated with future disability, relapses and MRI changes.

lead.h: Oral belzutifan is associated with regression of retinal capillary hemangioblastomas in von Hippel-Lindau disease
lead.ctx: In a retrospective National Eye Institute case series of 33 patients (42 eyes, 85 active lesions), mean total active lesion area per eye fell from 5.8 to 1.2 mm² at 1 year and to 0.5 mm² at 2 years, with no new lesions during treatment. Among patients who discontinued therapy, over 70% of eyes showed signs of relapse.
lead.why: The series supports the authors' view that belzutifan may have a role for juxtapapillary tumors and as adjunctive therapy for large or multifocal lesions, but frequent relapse after stopping suggests continued treatment may be needed to maintain control.

numbers.label: Average decrease in total active lesion area per eye at 1 year on belzutifan.
Fewer anti-VEGF injections over 12 months with micropulse laser plus anti-VEGF (pooled mean difference).

items.h: Baseline anatomy and early fluid response are associated with longer faricimab intervals in nAMD (JAMA Ophthalmology post hoc analysis of TENAYA and LUCERNE)
items.ctx: Of 558 faricimab-treated participants analyzed, 310 always received every-12- or every-16-week dosing, which was associated with thinner baseline central subfield thickness (OR 1.87 per 100-μm decrease; 95% CI, 1.24–2.81), thinner maximum PED (OR 1.40 per 100-μm decrease; 95% CI, 1.25–1.57), and absence of subretinal fluid at week 12 (OR 2.48; 95% CI, 1.42–4.34); P values were nominal and the every-20-week analysis is exploratory.

items.h: Pre- or intraoperative conbercept is associated with less early, but not late, postoperative vitreous hemorrhage after vitrectomy for PDR (BJO, QILIN I)
items.ctx: In a prospective, nonrandomized cohort of 425 eyes at 26 hospitals, early (7–30 day) postoperative vitreous hemorrhage occurred in 24.0% with preoperative and 23.2% with intraoperative conbercept vs 37.6% with vitrectomy alone, while late (30–180 day) rates and BCVA did not differ significantly between groups; no confidence intervals were reported.

items.h: Adaptive optics cone metrics track ischemia severity in diabetic macular ischemia in a small pilot study (BJO)
items.ctx: In 7 eyes with diabetic macular ischemia, cone density index correlated with ETDRS ischemia grade (rs = −0.90) and retinal sensitivity (r = +0.94), with cone changes often present without ellipsoid zone disruption on OCT; the sample is very small (7 eyes from 5 patients), and the control eye count differs between the abstract (7) and the full text (6)

items.h: Zone I stage 3 ROP without plus accounted for a larger share of treated eyes in Ghana than in the US (BJO, GHANAROP and SUNDROP)
items.ctx: In prospective telemedicine screening of 1,164 premature infants, this phenotype made up 40% of treated eyes in Ghana vs 7.5% in the US, while plus disease drove 30% vs 82.5% of treatments, based on 60 treated eyes in a single-grader analysis; the authors argue for integrated zone, stage, and plus scoring in low- and middle-income settings.

items.h: No intracameral antibiotic regimen was superior for preventing endophthalmitis after cataract surgery in a Swedish national register study (BJO)
items.ctx: Across 979,534 procedures from 2018 to 2024 there were 131 cases (0.013%), with rates of 0.017% for cefuroxime alone, 0.011% for cefuroxime plus ampicillin, and 0.010% for moxifloxacin, and 48% of affected patients had final visual acuity below 20/200.

items.h: FDA clears IND for OPGx-RDH12 gene therapy
items.ctx: The AAV-based therapy delivers a functional RDH12 gene to photoreceptors; trial enrollment size has not been disclosed.

items.h: Alvotech and Advanz submit the first known application for an aflibercept 8 mg biosimilar, to the EMA
items.ctx: AVT29 was filed as a line extension of the EU authorization for Mynzepli, their aflibercept 2 mg biosimilar; the companies note that biosimilarity has not yet been established by regulators.

items.h: Brepocitinib CLARITY-1 and CLARITY-2 topline results
items.ctx: Treatment lasted 48 weeks (double-masked), starting with an 8-week oral corticosteroid regimen (60 mg/day for 2 weeks, then a mandatory 6-week taper to zero); benefits were reported as consistent across intermediate, posterior, and panuveitis, 3% discontinued for adverse events, and no new safety signals were identified.

items.h: Alcon to own Encelto for MacTel
items.ctx: Alcon expects the deal to be slightly dilutive to core diluted EPS in 2027 and accretive thereafter; milestone amounts were not disclosed.

items.h: Silicone oil and gas tamponade show similar anatomical success in giant retinal tear detachments (Graefe's meta-analysis)
items.ctx: Across 9 studies (619 eyes), final anatomical success did not differ (RR 1.00; 95% CI, 0.96–1.03), nor did primary success (RR 1.08; 95% CI, 0.98–1.20), with certainty of evidence rated low to very low.

items.h: CHMP recommends approval of Fovlussea, a ranibizumab biosimilar
items.ctx: The EMA committee adopted a positive opinion for Accord Healthcare's Lucentis biosimilar for nAMD, DMO, proliferative diabetic retinopathy, RVO-related macular oedema, and CNV; the European Commission decision is pending.

items.h: Surrozen closes approximately $95.1 million financing tranche after SZN-8141 IND clearance
items.ctx: The second tranche of its March 2025 private placement, triggered by the Oct 2 FDA IND clearance for the intravitreal candidate SZN-8141, funds the DUET phase 1b/2a study in DME and initial phase 1b development of SZN-8143 (being developed for DME, wet AMD, and uveitic macular edema), with cash runway expected into 2029.

items.h: Baseline PED height is the most consistently reported association with RPE tears in nAMD (AJO meta-analysis)
items.ctx: In a review of 16 studies (4,043 eyes), eyes that tore had greater baseline PED height (5 studies, 425 eyes; MD 212.39 µm; 95% CI, 133.87–290.91) and area (4 studies, 1,360 eyes; MD 5.80 mm²; 95% CI, 3.48–8.12); anti-VEGF agent choice was not consistently associated, and certainty was very low, so these are associations rather than validated predictors.

items.h: Long-term follow-up of EMAP in Japanese patients suggests involvement extending beyond the macula (Graefe's)
items.ctx: In 8 genetically screened patients followed a mean 102.5 months, mean BCVA fell from 0.18 to 1.08 logMAR (right eye), 87.5% had peripheral paving-stone-like degeneration, and 62.5% had reduced rod responses; a small retrospective series.

items.h: Liposomal encapsulation protects bevacizumab from silicone oil-induced aggregation in vitro (TVST)
items.ctx: Liposomal bevacizumab stayed stable and unaggregated after up to 4 weeks of exposure to Siluron 1000 and Densiron Xtra, unlike non-formulated drug; in vivo efficacy and release kinetics are untested.

items.h: German National Cohort describes fundus imaging and visual acuity data in 48,460 adults as an AI research resource (Ophthalmology Science)
items.ctx: In this population-based baseline, 68.2% of nondilated fundus images were gradable and standard deep learning models predicted age with a mean absolute error of 2.96 years.

items.h: Masked expert ratings of four consumer LLMs on anterior segment questions find quality differences and a post hoc severe-safety signal (Ophthalmology Science)
items.ctx: Eleven cornea specialists rated Claude and Grok higher than ChatGPT and Gemini on quality across 45 questions, with no significant difference in mean safety, but post hoc more questions drew at least one severe safety rating for Claude (35.6%) and Grok (33.3%) than for ChatGPT (6.7%) or Gemini (11.1%); the authors call this hypothesis-generating.

items.h: Duravyu misses noninferiority again in LUCIA, its second phase 3 wet AMD trial
items.ctx: The vorolanib insert (2.7 mg every 24 weeks; n=475) missed BCVA noninferiority vs aflibercept 2 mg every 8 weeks, as LUGANO did. Effect sizes were not disclosed.

items.h: LUCIA secondary endpoints: 38% lower treatment burden, 52% of eyes supplement-free through week 56
items.ctx: The 38% reduction vs aflibercept carried a nominal p<0.0001. EyePoint reports no drug-related safety signals across more than 630 patients in six trials.

items.h: EyePoint plans to end both wet AMD trials early, cut about 53% of staff, and prioritize DME
items.ctx: The COMO and CAPRI DME trials (n=551) are expected to read out in Q4 2027.

items.h: COOG2: cytopathology does not modify 15-GEP/PRAME prognostic accuracy in uveal melanoma
items.ctx: In 1,537 patients, metastasis outcomes did not differ by cytopathology within any GEP/PRAME class.

items.h: Three-year prospective OCTA study in type 2 diabetes finds small but significant longitudinal microvascular changes
items.ctx: The study followed 328 eyes imaged every 4 months vs 33 control eyes imaged yearly. The severe NPDR finding is exploratory (6 eyes).
